common_symptoms: Runny or blocked nose; sneezing; mild sore throat; cough
home_care_suggestions: Rest; drink water and warm fluids; use saline nasal spray; consider a clean humidifier
what_to_avoid: Smoking and smoke exposure; very hot steam inhalation due to burn risk; antibiotics unless prescribed
when_to_seek_medical_care: Difficulty breathing; chest pain; dehydration; symptoms that worsen or do not improve; high or persistent fever
safety_notes: Comfort measures may ease symptoms but do not cure the virus. Seek advice for infants, older adults, pregnancy, or chronic illness.

home_care_suggestions: Drink fluids; try a warm drink; honey may soothe cough for people older than 1 year
what_to_avoid: Honey for children under 1 year; smoke exposure; starting medicines without checking age, conditions, and interactions
when_to_seek_medical_care: Shortness of breath; chest pain; coughing blood; blue lips; confusion; persistent or worsening cough
safety_notes: A cough can have many causes. This row is not a diagnosis or a treatment plan.

common_symptoms: Throat pain or irritation without emergency symptoms
home_care_suggestions: Drink comfortable warm or cool fluids; gargle warm salt water only if able to gargle and spit safely; rest
what_to_avoid: Very hot drinks; gargling in young children or anyone unable to spit safely; smoke exposure
when_to_seek_medical_care: Difficulty breathing or swallowing saliva; drooling; severe dehydration; severe or persistent symptoms
safety_notes: Do not assume the cause is bacterial or recommend antibiotics automatically.

common_symptoms: Mild head pain without sudden onset or neurological warning signs
home_care_suggestions: Drink water; rest in a quiet room; take a break from screens; eat regular meals if able
what_to_avoid: Ignoring a sudden severe headache or new neurological symptoms; recommending medication without checking suitability
when_to_seek_medical_care: Sudden worst-ever headache; weakness; confusion; fainting; stiff neck with fever; head injury; vision or speech changes
safety_notes: New, recurrent, severe, or worsening headaches need professional assessment.

common_symptoms: Feeling sick without severe pain or dehydration
home_care_suggestions: Take small frequent sips of fluid; try small bland meals if tolerated; rest
what_to_avoid: Large meals if they worsen symptoms; unverified herbal remedies; forcing food or fluids if unable to keep them down
when_to_seek_medical_care: Blood in vomit; severe abdominal pain; confusion; signs of dehydration; persistent vomiting; pregnancy with concerning symptoms
safety_notes: Possible causes vary widely. Seek prompt advice if symptoms persist or worsen.
source_basis: General self-care guidance; review with a qualified clinician before production use

common_symptoms: Loose stools without blood or severe dehydration
home_care_suggestions: Use oral rehydration solution prepared according to packet instructions; drink fluids; eat tolerated foods
what_to_avoid: Uncertain homemade solution ratios; alcohol; ignoring dehydration; anti-diarrheal medicine without checking suitability
when_to_seek_medical_care: Blood or black stool; severe abdominal pain; fainting; very little urine; inability to keep fluids down; high fever
safety_notes: Children, older adults, and people with chronic illness can dehydrate quickly and may need earlier medical advice.
source_basis: General self-care guidance; review with a qualified clinician before production use

common_symptoms: Infrequent or hard stools without severe pain or vomiting
home_care_suggestions: Drink adequate fluids; increase dietary fiber gradually; move or walk if able; maintain a regular toilet routine
what_to_avoid: Sudden large increases in fiber if it causes significant discomfort; laxatives without checking suitability when symptoms are new or severe
when_to_seek_medical_care: Severe abdominal pain; vomiting; swollen abdomen; blood in stool; inability to pass gas; persistent symptoms
safety_notes: Persistent or new constipation deserves medical review, especially with weight loss or blood.
source_basis: General self-care guidance; review with a qualified clinician before production use

common_symptoms: Localized mild itching or irritation without swelling of the face or breathing symptoms
home_care_suggestions: Apply a cool compress; use gentle fragrance-free skin care; avoid scratching; stop using a suspected irritating product
what_to_avoid: Applying bleach, strong essential oils, or unknown mixtures; using steroid or antifungal creams without appropriate advice
when_to_seek_medical_care: Trouble breathing; swelling of lips or tongue; rapidly spreading rash; fever with rash; severe pain; blistering; signs of infection
safety_notes: A rash may have many causes including allergy or infection; home care does not identify or cure the cause.
source_basis: General self-care guidance; review with a qualified clinician before production use

common_symptoms: Muscle discomfort after ordinary activity without major injury
home_care_suggestions: Rest from aggravating activity; gentle movement as tolerated; use a wrapped cool pack for a recent minor strain
what_to_avoid: Applying ice directly to skin; pushing through severe pain; heat or massage over major injuries
when_to_seek_medical_care: Severe swelling; deformity; inability to use the limb; weakness or numbness; dark urine after intense exercise
safety_notes: Advice applies only to mild soreness without red flags or significant injury.
source_basis: General self-care guidance; review with a qualified clinician before production use

common_symptoms: Typical lower abdominal cramps around menstruation without unusual severe symptoms
home_care_suggestions: Use a comfortably warm heat pack wrapped in cloth; gentle movement; rest
what_to_avoid: Excessive heat that can burn skin; assuming severe or new pelvic pain is normal
when_to_seek_medical_care: Severe or sudden pelvic pain; fainting; possible pregnancy with pain or bleeding; very heavy bleeding; fever
safety_notes: New, severe, or changing symptoms require assessment.
source_basis: General self-care guidance; review with a qualified clinician before production use

common_symptoms: Thirst, dry mouth, darker urine, mild light-headedness
home_care_suggestions: Take frequent small sips of water; consider oral rehydration solution if losing fluids through diarrhea or vomiting
what_to_avoid: Relying only on sugary drinks; delaying care when unable to drink or urination is very low
when_to_seek_medical_care: Confusion; fainting; inability to keep fluids down; very little or no urine; severe weakness
doctor_specialty_to_consider: Primary care / urgent care depending on severity
safety_notes: People with fluid restrictions due to heart or kidney conditions should follow their clinician's advice.

common_symptoms: Sneezing; itchy or watery eyes; runny nose after common triggers
home_care_suggestions: Reduce exposure to known triggers; rinse face after outdoor exposure; consider saline nasal spray
what_to_avoid: Unverified herbal remedies; assuming wheezing or breathing difficulty is a mild allergy
when_to_seek_medical_care: Difficulty breathing; throat or tongue swelling; faintness; severe or persistent symptoms
doctor_specialty_to_consider: Primary care / Allergy specialist if appropriate
safety_notes: Sudden breathing difficulty or swelling can be an emergency. This does not replace diagnosis or allergy treatment.
